notes: Page headed "STATION 48" (the report's own station number) and "MIDDLE FORK, EAGLE CANYON CREEK". Location: "Lat. 34°29'00", long. 119°55'40", in Eagle Canyon at upper-most diversion about 3.0 miles north of Highway 101." Description: measuring site at diversion box 2,600 feet above Eagle Canyon Road; diversion abandoned. Typescript is faint (degrees of latitude and longitude read from an enlarged copy). Three dates, the first "No flow"; discharge printed in second-feet and gallons per minute. Mar. 30 has no year printed and follows Jan. 17, 1949. No county or state on the page.
